name: Jasper Designer
author: Centrix Suite
summary: Turn scanned or PDF forms into Jasper print-out reports, publish them to JasperServer and register them in Centrix HIS.
description: Crop pages or areas from PDF files, or upload images, put them in page order, and publish them as a one-page or multi-page JRXML report unit on JasperServer. Optionally registers the report as a Visit Slip report template in the connected Centrix site, with an audit log entry. The JRXML can also be downloaded for Jaspersoft Studio.
features: Crop A4 pages or any area from one or more PDF files
Upload images and drag pages into order
Publish single-page or multi-page reports to JasperServer
Register the report as a Visit Slip in Centrix HIS (report templates)
Download the JRXML, or a ZIP with images, for Jaspersoft Studio
Save the pages to the Jasper Designer file manager (folders, replace, delete) then open them again here or in Jasper Designer
Publish Report: send saved Jasper Designer reports to JasperServer, optionally saving them to Centrix HIS
Deploy workflow: deploy to the UAT JasperServer, run and approve the report there, then deploy the approved version to Production
Jasper Designer: drag-and-drop report design (text, images, barcodes, shapes incl. ellipses, checkboxes, radios, subreports) with JRXML source, publish and PDF preview
Reports Overview: charts of the designs, publishing, the UAT -> Production deploys and the HIS report templates
Settings: one page for the JasperServers (publish to one or several at once), Centrix HIS registration and each tool's defaults, set by an administrator
requires: JasperServer REST access (set in Reports > Settings)
MongoDB connection to register reports in HIS

actions.description: Publish the print-out straight to JasperServer (when Reports > Settings allows it)
Save print-outs and create folders in the Jasper Designer library
Delete saved designs and empty folders
Publish the design straight to JasperServer (when Reports > Settings allows it)
Delete saved designs and empty folders
Publish saved reports straight to the chosen JasperServers (when Reports > Settings allows it)
Send saved reports to the UAT JasperServers
Approve a report checked on UAT for Production, or reject it
Send approved reports to the Production JasperServers (and Centrix HIS)
